content.value: Use java.io.File with java.util.Scanner to read persistent data. Import IOException and handle or declare file-opening failures. Match token types with nextInt, nextDouble, nextBoolean, or next; use nextLine for line-oriented reading. Check for remaining input and close the scanner. String.split with a simple delimiter separates fields.

Precondition: every token in scores.txt is a valid int. For tokens 4 7 9 the result is 20; an empty file produces zero. hasNext checks availability, not numeric validity. AP practice here uses file input and does not mix nextLine with token-reading calls.
Practice: trace the example by hand, change one input, and explain how the result changes. Check an empty or boundary case when the preconditions allow it.
